reduction: cca (matrix-free svds) — identical construction to prep_04_link.py

reproduction_gate.statistic: per-cell equality of the UNRESTRICTED greedy nearest neighbour implied by the re-derived space

link_x_donor.solver_note: a stall is scipy LAPJVsp failing to converge, not an infeasible graph; see BudgetedMatcher and out/b04b_solver_equivalence.json

link_x_celltype_donor.solver_note: a stall is scipy LAPJVsp failing to converge, not an infeasible graph; see BudgetedMatcher and out/b04b_solver_equivalence.json

cost_conditioning.rescaled: (c - min c)/(max c - min c); EXACT — every full matching uses exactly m edges, so a positive-slope affine map is strictly increasing in the matching cost and cannot reorder matchings
cost_conditioning.quantized: the rescaled costs rounded onto a 1e+09 grid; approximate, total error over a full matching bounded by m * 0.5/GRID of the cost range (~1.2e-5 raw cost units at the largest block here, against optimal costs of order 1e4). Deterministic; no RNG.
cost_conditioning.empirical_check: prep_04c_solver_equivalence.py re-solves every block on the raw and the conditioned costs and compares the two matchings cell by cell; verdict in out/b04b_solver_equivalence.json
cost_conditioning.why_needed: scipy LAPJVsp does not converge on some of these graphs — measured, and not an infeasibility (maximum_bipartite_matching finds a perfect matching on the same graph in ~0.02 s). See the BudgetedMatcher docstring for the timings.

method: prep_04_link.py's CCA linkage with the candidate edge set restricted to within-block pairs; see module docstring

reference_graph_from_b04_link_report.fallback_note: edges added at 1000x max cost purely to guarantee a perfect matching exists; a large count means the arm is not a nearest-neighbour bijection
